necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmia. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, prolonged rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources or symptomatic dysrhythmias. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
